text: Level three, question six: a boat's still-water speed is ten kilometres per hour; it goes twenty-four kilometres downstream and returns in five hours in all; find the stream speed. Question seven: a boat covers twenty-four kilometres upstream and thirty-six downstream in six hours, and thirty-six upstream and twenty-four downstream in six and a half hours; find u and v. Question eight: a boat with a still-water speed of twelve kilometres per hour goes downstream and returns over the same distance, and the stream flows at four kilometres per hour; find the average speed for the round trip.
